session_note: Maryland's 2026 Regular Session convened 2026-01-14 and adjourned Sine Die on 2026-04-13 (second Monday in April), confirmed from the bill history of HB1532/HB0293 which show final floor action on that date; Maryland's 90-day fixed session does not carry bills into a future year, so any 2026 bill without a recorded committee vote or floor passage by 2026-04-13 died at adjournment (failed_died), and only bills the Governor signed (or let become law) after that date count as enacted.
